Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This page explains what personal data PackJoyU collects through this website, why, and how long we keep it.
Privacy.contactLink: Contact us through the inquiry form

collected.title: Data we collect
items: Inquiries and quote requests: your name, email, company, phone, country and message, plus the products and options you choose.
Sample requests: the above plus your shipping address.
Logos you upload with an inquiry.
Shared custom designs you create in the 3D customizer.
Technical data: your IP address (used only for rate limiting and abuse protection) and, if you allow analytics, anonymous page-performance metrics.

purpose.title: Why we use it
items: To answer inquiries, prepare quotes and ship samples.
To protect the site from spam and abuse (security check and rate limits).
With your consent only: to measure site performance and to offer live chat.

items.designs: Shared custom designs expire after 180 days (the link then returns “410 Gone”) and are deleted 90 days later.
items.logos: Logos not attached to an inquiry are deleted after 24 hours.
items.sampleEmail: For sample requests (one per email every 30 days), the email used for this limit is cleared after 30 days.
items.rateLimit: Per-IP rate-limit counters expire when the rate-limit window ends.
items.audit: Audit logs are deleted after 365 days.
items.inquiries: Inquiries are anonymized after 2 years; logos attached to an inquiry are deleted with it.
items.onRequest: On request, we delete or anonymize your contact details, messages, shipping address, emails and logos, keeping only non-personal statistics.
items.exports: Data exports are delivered to you as a file; no copy is kept on the server.
items.cleanup: An automatic cleanup runs once a day.

cookies.title: Cookies, local storage and consent
items: Your choice is stored in your browser’s localStorage under the key pj-consent, not in a cookie. It records whether you allowed analytics and chat, and when.
Analytics (anonymous performance metrics) load only after you allow them.
Live chat (Tawk.to) loads only after you allow it.
Your choice expires after 12 months, and we ask again.

You can change or withdraw consent at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer. After you withdraw, analytics and chat stop loading; withdrawing chat also clears the chat provider’s data from your browser.

chat.title: Live chat (Tawk.to)
items: Live chat is provided by Tawk.to and is loaded only if you allow chat.
When it loads, Tawk.to receives your messages and technical data needed to run the chat, and sets its own storage in your browser.
The chat never loads on our admin pages.

contact.title: Contact and your rights
text: You can ask us to access, export, correct or delete your data.
